_about: Enacted laws still driving proceedings on this dashboard. Caption, author and last action are pulled from Texas Legislature Online; 'why' is my note.

bills.why: Large load law. It drives the large load rulemakings here (Projects 58481 and 58482) and, per Staff's August 13 memo, the transmission cost recovery review (Projects 58484 and 58000).
Per Staff's August 13 memo, this 2023 law directed ERCOT to create Dispatchable Reliability Reserve Service, which is still being built out through NPRR1310 and NPRR1340.
